report:
# Read: unit U3b2 of goal the-deputy-acts-under-a-recorded-delegation

Subject: worktree diff against 576bbddc30e2a6215f26c9f69da796831eda025f (SHA-256 12bf59c0bb68cbdb99a343577f103a20af665ae69e7bbe6d9d5e97f42dd6a4e3; read.diff is byte-identical), judged against the build brief (H3/T8c and AM10 N12-N16).

## Result: AGREE

No material findings. Every change the brief asks of U3b2 is present, correct and tested:

- H3 / T8c. `Situation.Undelivered` counts, over the whole decision log, the decisions that have a `Grant` and are not in the delivered set. That is H1's selection (`DeliverDecisions`) without the day rule, read from the same `decisions-delivered.json` next to the same board home. The authority summary renders "N decisions under a grant not yet sent to you" only when N > 0, and the 20 shown decisions stay. An unreadable delivered set becomes an authority problem instead of a silent zero. `TestTheSituationCountsUnsentDecisions` uses 25 grant decisions plus one person decision, with ids 22-24 delivered, so it catches both the "count only the shown 20" mutation (17) and a dropped Grant filter (23). It also covers the all-delivered case and the unreadable set.
- N12. The budget arm takes G from `--id G`, `--goal G`, `--id=G` or `--goal=G` before `--`; otherwise it takes the first goal target in the effect. Real decisions record `{"targets":[verbresult.Target...]}` (`intent_decision.go:182-193`; `Target` marshals as kind/id), so the effect fallback reads what production writes. The test rows `--goal G`, `--goal=G` and `--id G` use a conflicting effect ("other"). Every row fails under the old skip.
- N13. `maxArgs: -1` plus `len(args) != 1` gives the refusal "grant show takes one grant id", with next `metasystem grant list`. Tested with zero ids and with two.
- N14. Text: `by` without `human:`, classes joined with ", ", and every `until` through `page.Env().Time`. JSON: `at` is RFC 3339 UTC, and a tiered `until` is the day after `Expires` at 00:00Z, the first instant `LiveAt` (`internal/goal/root.go:193-201`, a UTC date compare) reads the grant as expired. Only the goldens this moves were regenerated (grant-show.json `at`, grant-show.txt by/classes, system-situation.json the new field appended); existing fields kept their place.
- N15. `helmTick` calls `noticeDecisions` beside `runPatterns`. The new `helm` mode of `TestEveryDecisionIsReportedOnce` runs `RunTick` at the helm on day 2, asserts the verdict stays helm, and asserts that day 1's 25 decisions arrive in one post and are not posted again on a second pass.
- N16. The "; overrule: " suffix is left out when the line is empty. The T8 row with an ordering decision (i == 12) asserts that the line has no "; overrule:".

Proof: the unit's proof command is `/usr/bin/true`, so it exercises nothing. The engine's frozen check for this round (`round-1/check-2118796608`, outcome passed) ran `metasystem test impact`. It selected the changed and new test functions in `cmd/metasystem`, including `TestBudgetOverruleNamesTheGoal`, `TestGrantShowFormatsTieredExpiry`, `TestGrantShowListsItsActs`, `TestTheOverruleUndoesWhatItCan`, `TestALateDecisionIsReportedNextTime`, `TestAnOverruleShowsItsImpactFirst` and the `TestAuditOutputLayout*` audits, plus the whole `internal/steward` and `internal/humanauthority` packages. The `^TestAudit` step also passed. The new tests cover failure paths as well as the happy path: refusals, a conflicting effect, an unreadable set, all delivered, and the helm.

## Non-gating observations (low, not material)

1. `metasystem/internal/steward/situation_compose.go` (wake): the diff also adds a wake fact `undelivered|N`. The brief does not ask for it and no test covers it. It makes `situation wait` report "changed" once a day per waiting seat, when the daily delivery drops the count, and that change is not something a seat acts on. Either drop it or give it a test row. RELATION: new
2. `metasystem/internal/steward/situation_compose.go` (authority summary): with N == 1 the line reads "1 decisions under a grant not yet sent to you". The `several` helper is already in `parts()`. The rule also applies to its sibling: the existing "%d decisions" in the same summary line. RELATION: new
3. `metasystem/internal/steward/tick.go:382-387`: the `helmTick` doc comment still lists only the patterns, the spent-box question, the claim quota and the duties among the helm's report passes. It leaves out decision delivery. RELATION: new
4. `metasystem/internal/steward/situation_test.go` (`TestTheSituationCountsUnsentDecisions`): the test never asserts that an "authority" part was found, so a missing part would pass in silence. Today `add` always appends the part. `TestBudgetOverruleNamesTheGoal` also has no `--id=G` row, although the code handles that form. RELATION: new

## Budget

17 of 48 tool calls used; every checklist item was checked. I did not run any tests myself: the engine's check log for this round already covers the selected tests, and the host load was about 10-12 on 18 cores.

VERDICT: land
